consensus: tolerate honest clock skew in block timestamps (fixes spurious "Block preparation failed: Invalid block timestamp" with no attacker anywhere). The rule was ZERO-tolerance (reject any stamp even 1 s ahead of the local clock) while production deliberately stamps max(now, parent_ts) — so one producer with a slightly fast clock poisoned the tip, the monotonic clamp propagated its stamp to every following HONEST producer, and any validator whose clock ran behind kept rejecting fresh honest blocks.

games: uninterrupted background signing NOW COVERS pets battles (+ tictactoe resign). The hidden-iframe signer was already SDK-wide (dapp.call attempts every non-confirm call in the background; live-probed nadoBgReady from ALL 9 game origins including pets), but pets force-confirmed its core battle actions (challenge/accept) with confirm:1 — so every battle yanked the tab to the wallet even in fully-automated mode, which read as 'pets doesn't have background signing'. Those two now let the WALLET policy decide, exactly like the same-class staked open/join in chess/farkle/coinflip: default wallets still get the visible confirm (needui → redirect fallback), auto-sign-all wallets play uninterrupted. Same alignment for tictactoe resign (chess resign already worked this way). Deliberate confirms stay: pets marketplace (buy/sell/transfer/offers) + permanent naming, slots close (cashes the bank out), poker bets.
